title: Chilli Con Carne
summary: Wholesome meal perfect for winter and is definitely...
extendedSummary: Wholesome meal perfect for winter, and is definitely Mika's favourite if he is ever feeling meh. I think it always tastes better with way more chilli powder than you expect.

items: 1 tsp sugar or a square of dark chocolate

method: Chop onion and red pepper and mince garlic
Cook onion until soft, add garlic, red capsicum, chilli, paprika and cumin and cook for a further 5 mins or until red pepper is starting to caramelize
Turn up the heat a bit to fry up the meat, and when brown, add the stock
If it gets too dry add more stock
Add tomatoes, marjoram, sugar (or choc) and tomato purée, and let simmer for ~20 mins on a lower heat
